facility_roles.quote: The general-purpose KLOE detector, comprising a 4 m-diameter drift chamber surrounded by a lead-scintillating-fibre electromagnetic calorimeter with very good energy and timing performance at low energies

intervals.label: expression of interest and upgrade
intervals.note: The KLOE-2 collaboration submitted an expression of interest on 31 March 2006 and a roll-in proposal in 2007; the Inner Tracker TDR is dated February 2010. The interval ends at the start of the KLOE-2 run.
intervals.quote: Expression of interest for the continuation of the KLOE physics program at DAΦNE upgraded in luminosity and in energy, March 31, 2006

intervals.label: DAΦNE data taking (KLOE-2)
intervals.note: Data taking concluded on 30 March 2018, with 5.5 fb^-1 acquired by KLOE-2 (about 8 fb^-1 with KLOE).
intervals.quote: then continued with KLOE-2 since November 2014

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: Analyses of KLOE-2 data are ongoing (CERN Courier).
intervals.quote: On 30 March the KLOE-2 experiment concluded its data-taking campaign

lineage.quote: KLOE-2 is the main particle physics experiment at Frascati National Laboratory (LNF) and represents the continuation of the KLOE experiment

name: KLOE-2
notes: The KLOE-2 detector is detector:kloe (shared with KLOE).

physics_goals.quote: extending the KLOE physics programme in precision tests of fundamental discrete symmetries and the quantum coherence of entangled neutral kaon pairs
physics_goals.value: Precision tests of discrete symmetries and the quantum coherence of entangled neutral kaon pairs; rare K_S and eta decays, gamma-gamma physics and dark-matter searches

summary.plain: The upgraded KLOE experiment at Frascati's DAΦNE, which took data from November 2014 to March 2018 and, with KLOE, recorded about 8 inverse femtobarns, the largest sample ever taken at the phi resonance. It added a cylindrical GEM inner tracker and tested crab-waist collisions with a detector solenoid.
summary.technical: KLOE-2: upgraded KLOE detector at DAΦNE with crab-waist collisions; expression of interest 31 March 2006; run November 2014-30 March 2018 with 5.5 fb⁻¹ acquired (about 8 fb⁻¹, 24 billion φ mesons, with KLOE); roughly 60-strong collaboration; physics on discrete symmetries, entangled neutral-kaon coherence, rare K_S and η decays, γγ physics and dark-matter searches.
